## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A ten-fascicle Chinese translation of the Sanskrit *Sarvāstivāda-vinaya-mātṛkā* — a systematic index/synopsis of the Sarvāstivāda Vinaya, expounding rule-categories, *karmavācanā* schemata, and inter-text cross-references. 摩得勒伽 *módélèjiā* transliterates *mātṛkā* ("matrix"). Translated by **Saṃghavarman** 僧伽跋摩 ([僧伽跋摩](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E5%83%A7%E4%BC%BD%E8%B7%8B%E6%91%A9)) at Jiànkāng in 433 CE, contemporary with Guṇavarman's [KR6k0015](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0015).

**Abstract**

The *mātṛkā* genre — systematic abhidharmic-style indexes of doctrinal categories — is one of the principal exegetical genres of the early Sarvāstivāda. This Vinaya-*mātṛkā* applies the same systematic approach to the monastic discipline, treating the rules and procedures under fixed analytical headings (*saṃgha*-types, *karma*-types, *paripūrṇa*-types, etc.). The work is a critical complement to the *Sàpóduō pínì pípóshā* ([KR6k0021](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0021)) and the *Shísòng lǜ* ([KR6k0016](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6k/KR6k0016)) for understanding the Sarvāstivāda Vinaya tradition.
